- Initial release of jisu-geoconvert skill.
- Provides conversion between latitude/longitude and addresses using Jisu API, supporting both Baidu and Google coordinate systems.
- Offers two main commands: coord2addr (convert coordinates to address) and addr2coord (convert address to coordinates).
- Requires JISU_API_KEY environment variable for authentication.
- Includes detailed error code documentation and sample command usage.
